name: Different Races
overview: Scripture teaches that all people, regardless of race, are created in the image of God and share a common human origin, as seen in Genesis 1:27 and Acts 17:26. God's impartiality is emphasized in Romans 2:11, showing that He does not show favoritism based on ethnicity or status. Furthermore, Galatians 3:28 highlights the unity believers have in Christ Jesus, transcending racial and social distinctions.
